info.title: NIMASA Seafarer Portal API
info.description:
Comprehensive API for the NIMASA Seafarer Management Portal.
                
                This API provides endpoints for:
                - User profile management
                - Document management
                - Organization and accreditation management
                - Service applications
                - Payment processing
                - And more...
                
                ## Authentication
                Most endpoints require JWT Bearer token authentication. Include the token in the Authorization header:
                ```
                Authorization: Bearer {your-token}
                ```
                
                ## API Versioning
                This API uses versioning to ensure backward compatibility. The current version is **1.0**.
                - Version can be specified via query string: `?version=1.0`
                - Or via header: `X-Version: 1.0`
                - Or via URL path: `/api/v1/...`
                
                ## Rate Limiting
                API requests are rate-limited to ensure fair usage. Contact support if you need higher limits.
                
                ## Support
                For API support, contact: support@nimasa.gov.ng
